annotations.text: The hard limit this exists to remove: atlas.ts takes an authored tile only when `sheets.size === 1`. Two materials drawn on different sheets can never meet today, whatever anyone draws.
The model terminates. A corner has four positions, so four materials is the most that can meet at one, and a four-material block is exactly 4! = 24 tiles. There is no fifth case to design.
Orientation does two jobs: it says where a material belongs (what `role` does today) and it disambiguates two transitions over the same materials — one for the floor, one for the wall.
Terrain stops being a noun the artist meets. It survives only inside a block, as how its tiles are read. Material is the one word for what a voxel is made of and what a transition is between.
OPEN: what happens to a project's existing per-sheet tags, and whether a run of tags that happens to cover a block should be recognised automatically or left for the artist to point at.
